weekly.name: Lapras
weekly.description: A wild Lapras appears in the basement of Union Cave every Friday. It can be battled and caught.

weekly.name: Bug Catching Contest
weekly.description: The Bug Catching Contest is held at National Park on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays. Compete to catch the best Bug-type Pokémon!

weekly.name: S.S. Aqua
weekly.description: The S.S. Aqua departs from Olivine Port on Mondays and Fridays, traveling between Johto and Kanto.

weekly.name: Older Haircut Brother
weekly.description: The older haircut brother works on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays for ¥500. He has a higher chance of making your Pokémon much happier.

weekly.name: Younger Haircut Brother
weekly.description: The younger haircut brother works on Sundays, Wednesdays, and Fridays for ¥300. He has more variable results but costs less.

weekly.name: Bargain Merchant
weekly.description: The Bargain Merchant appears on Monday mornings only in the Goldenrod Underground, selling items at discounted prices.

weekly.name: Bitter Merchant
weekly.description: The Bitter Merchant appears on weekends (Saturday and Sunday) in the Goldenrod Underground, selling bitter herbs that heal Pokémon but reduce happiness.
